findings.title: Handle authorized requests without an organization member
findings.body: Organization-scoped API/integration authentication can be authorized to read audit logs without a user membership, leaving organization_context.member as None. Dereferencing member.has_global_access then raises AttributeError for these non-superuser requests. Because this expression is evaluated even when optimized_pagination is absent, the change breaks the existing audit-log path as well. Check the optional membership safely and evaluate eligibility only when the optimized path is requested.

findings.title: The optimized paginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint selects this paginator with order_by="-datetime", so the item value here is a datetime object. math.ceil/math.floor cannot accept that value, and building cursors for any nonempty first page raises TypeError. value_from_cursor also returns the encoded numeric value unchanged instead of converting it back to a datetime, making existing timestamp cursors invalid for the query. Use DateTimePaginator's timestamp encoding and decoding for this endpoint.

findings.title: Django querysets do not support negative slicing
findings.body: The advanced-feature branch passes a negative cursor offset directly into a Django QuerySet slice. Django explicitly rejects negative slice bounds with ValueError("Negative indexing is not supported."); it does not handle them automatically as the comment claims. Consequently, every negative-offset request through this branch fails instead of performing reverse pagination. Implement reverse traversal using ordering and nonnegative bounds, or reject unsupported offsets with BadPaginationError.
